messages:
maria: kicking off migration window for release v3.14.1 now. primary change is a partial index on events(payload->>'type') and an offline reindex of events_idx_partial. planning short canary, then full backfill if green.
chris: @maria ack. which services need pinning?
josh: pin api v3.14.1 and worker v2.9.0 for the window. CLI: `deploy pin --service api --version 3.14.1` `deploy pin --service worker --version 2.9.0`
maria: adding to release notes: "DB: partial index + reindex for events table; adds filter on payload.type='interaction' to speed queries."
db-sre: flagging that events is heavy. plan: run index create concurrently on replicas, roll to primary during low traffic with lock_timeout and statement_timeout. also: watch replication lag.
maria: plan: 1) canary on shard-a replica, 2) run concurrent index create on replicas, 3) reindex on replicas, 4) schedule primary cutover in the 02:00 UTC maintenance window if lag < 2s, else postpone.
deploy-bot: Started job 47291: canary-deploy (api=3.14.1, worker=2.9.0)
sre-bot: Observability runbook attached: https://go/readbooks/runbooks/db-index-backfill
chris: small canary started against shard-a svc-nyc. watchers: @maria @josh @db-sre
deploy-bot: canary logs:
```
Job 47291: canary started
Health checks: api/300ms, worker/1200ms
No errors in 5m
```
chris: canary looks clean. proceeding to create index on replicas now.
db-sre: started create index concurrently on replica shards (sql snippet):
```
SET lock_timeout = '5s';
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS events_idx_partial ON events ((payload->>'type')) WHERE (payload->>'type') = 'interaction';
```
chris: replicas responded with low impact. replication lag observed: 0.5-1.2s. good to proceed.
maria: starting reindex on replica-shard-b now (slow, but fine).
db-sre: reindex kicked off with maintenance worker pool. progress: ~12% after 10m. no locks observed against writes.
sre-bot: monitoring: token cost spike in worker queue due to backfill, scaled workers up per autoscaling policy.
josh: heads-up: queries hitting events table from analytics might time out. added temporary route to pin analytics to read-replica.
chris: mid-run note: one replica reported a long waiting lock on events: index build holding an AccessExclusive attempted? Investigating.
db-sre: found a legacy migration job that took an advisory lock on events for a compaction. killed job (id=882) after contacting owner. set lock_timeout to 3s for the remainder of the window.
maria: decision: abort any reindex attempt on primary for tonight. we'll finish replicas; primary cutover deferred to next low-traffic window. add escape hatch commands to run if primary stalls.
josh: escape hatch (if primary gets blocked):
```
-- if index build blocks writes for > 1m
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX%' AND state = 'active' AND now() - query_start > interval '60 seconds';
-- or force drop index attempt (last resort)
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS events_idx_partial;
```
chris: i've posted a pinned note in the release channel with the rollback matrix and who to call. @db-sre please add final checklist.
db-sre: added checklist to the runbook and updated the deploy ticket with final status: replicas done, reindex progress 100% on replica shards, primary pending. recommended: schedule primary apply in maintenance window Tue 02:00 UTC, owners: @maria @db-sre.
maria: adding a line to release notes: "Primary reindex deferred; replicas indexed. Primary cutover scheduled Tue 02:00 UTC; rollback plan available."
sre-bot: Tagged incident-monitor for short-term latency checks through end of window.
deploy-bot: Job 47291: canary -> success, post-canary workflow paused awaiting manual approval for primary cutover.
chris: thanks all. closing out for tonight. ping if replication lag spikes or if any query timeouts surface. :white_check_mark:
